abort.single_instance_allowed: Shabbat Scheduler is already set up. Only one instance is supported.

data_description.candle_sensor: The Jewish Calendar sensor giving the upcoming candle-lighting time. Its entity id is derived from that integration's own title, so it may not be the default shown here.
data_description.havdalah_sensor: The Jewish Calendar sensor giving the upcoming havdalah time. Its entity id is derived from that integration's own title, so it may not be the default shown here.

zmanim_sensor_missing.title: The configured zmanim sensors can't be read
zmanim_sensor_missing.description: Shabbat Scheduler cannot read {candle_sensor} and/or {havdalah_sensor}. Check that the Jewish Calendar integration is set up and that those entity ids are still correct, then change them from the integration's Configure options if not. Nothing is scheduled until they can be read.

unmigrated_rules.title: Some rules could not be migrated
unmigrated_rules.description: Upgrading from the previous version could not convert these rules automatically, so they were kept, disabled: {rule_ids}. Open each one to see why, then re-enable or recreate it.

split_rules.title: Some rules were split by the upgrade
split_rules.description: The previous version could drive several kinds of device from one rule; a rule now names one action, so these rules were split into one rule per device type and all of them are still active: {rules}. Nothing was lost and nothing needs fixing — check the card looks the way you expect, then dismiss this. Each new rule keeps a copy of the original, which the YAML export shows.

simulate.name: Simulate
simulate.description: Resolve the schedule for a block without side effects.

block_length.name: Block length
block_length.description: Days to simulate. Defaults to the upcoming block.

set_dry_run.name: Set dry run
set_dry_run.description: When enabled, rules report what they would change but call no services.

export_yaml.name: Export YAML
export_yaml.description: Return the whole rule set as YAML.

import_yaml.name: Import YAML
import_yaml.description: Replace the whole rule set from YAML.
